title: The American Pickup Nobody Wants Anymore (And the One Everyone Does)
sources: Motor Authority, Nissan Titan ends after 2024 model year: https://www.motorauthority.com/news/1140417_nissan-titan-dies-after-2024

scenes.text: In 2022, Nissan sold just fifteen thousand Titan pickups in America. That was a forty-five percent drop in a single year.
scenes.caption: TITAN 2022: 15,063 SOLD (-45%)

scenes.text: Nissan then confirmed the truck would end after the twenty twenty-four model year.
scenes.caption: PRODUCTION ENDED AFTER 2024

scenes.text: But here is the twist. In 2025, Ford sold eight hundred one thousand F-Series trucks. More than fifty times the Titan.
scenes.caption: FORD F-SERIES 2025: 801,525 SOLD

scenes.text: So Americans still love pickups. They just stopped buying the wrong ones. Next: five trucks buyers are quietly walking away from.
scenes.caption: 5 TRUCKS BUYERS ARE LEAVING
